basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Oulu International Master's Scholarship & Finland Scholarship
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Oulu & Finnish Ministry of Education and Culture
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Oulu Linnanmaa & Kontinkangas Campuses (Oulu, Northern Ostrobothnia, Finland)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Faculty of Information Technology and Electrical Engineering (ITEE): Wireless Communications Engineering (6G Flagship), Computer Science and Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering and Information Systems, Biomedical Engineering, and Electronics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~150 to 200 tuition fee waivers and Finland Scholarships awarded across international Master's cohorts annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Merit-based international competition; Pakistani STEM scholars secure ~12 to 20 awards and tuition waivers annually
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years (full standard duration of 120 ECTS Master of Science program), renewal in year 2 contingent on completing minimum 60 ECTS in year 1

nationality_requirements: International non-EU/EEA students subject to Finnish tuition fees (Pakistan fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No age restriction; candidates assessed on academic excellence and prerequisite coursework.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: A recognized 4-year Bachelor of Science / Engineering in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Software Engineering, or related STEM field (16 years education) with minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00 (or 75%+ marks) from an HEC-recognized university in Pakistan.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum ECTS grade equivalent of Grade B or Finnish grade 3.5 / 5.0 in major subject studies.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial coursework in mathematics (calculus, linear algebra, probability), programming languages (C/C++, Python), computer architecture, and telecommunications fundamentals.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduating seniors in their final semester can apply conditionally with official provisional transcripts.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; technical software projects, telecom internships, or hardware lab experience are advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 overall (minimum 5.5 in writing) or TOEFL iBT minimum 92 (minimum 22 in writing). Finnish universities strictly require standardized English test reports.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; international programs are taught 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Applicants apply for the scholarship simultaneously with their study program on the national Finnish portal Studyinfo.fi.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold another full Finnish state scholarship concurrently.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for the first academic year (worth €12,000 - €13,000 / year). For the second year, 70% to 100% waiver is renewed upon completing minimum 60 ECTS in year one.

admission_application_fee.details: Application via the official Finnish national portal Studyinfo.fi is free of charge.

accommodation.details: Subsidized student apartments provided by Northern Ostrobothnia Student Housing Foundation (PSOAS); monthly rent €250 - €380 including utilities and internet.

monthly_stipend.details: Finland Scholarship recipients receive a one-time relocation grant of €5,000 upon arrival to cover initial living expenses. Additionally, campus research assistant (tutkimusavustaja) positions pay €12 - €16/hour for up to 20 hrs/week.
monthly_stipend.amount: €5,000 relocation grant (~PKR 1,500,000) + part-time campus research earnings

airfare.details: International air travel must be arranged by the student; easily covered by the €5,000 Finland Scholarship arrival grant.

visa_fee.details: Finnish Immigration Service (Migri) first residence permit electronic application fee (€350).

health_insurance.details: International students purchase private health insurance (Swisscare or SIP ~€250/year) for the Migri residence permit; once enrolled, mandatory Finnish Student Health Service (FSHS / YTHS) provides free outpatient healthcare on campus for ~€74/year.
health_insurance.amount: Private insurance ~€250/year; campus healthcare included via FSHS

food_allowance.details: Finnish government (Kela) subsidizes university student meals; balanced warm lunch costs only €2.95 at campus restaurants (Uniresta).
food_allowance.amount: Subsidized Kela student meals (€2.95 per meal)

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Full access to Pegasus University Library, software licenses, 6G Flagship laboratory hardware, and RF test facilities.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty funding available through the 6G Flagship research group for Master's thesis students publishing papers in IEEE conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Oulu local public transit (Oulun joukkoliikenne / Onni) offers 50% discounted student bus passes (~€35 / month).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single renowned Finnish research university: University of Oulu.
participating_institutions: University of Oulu (Linnanmaa Campus, Oulu, Finland)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 300 globally in QS/THE World Rankings; globally recognized #1 pioneer in 6G wireless research (hosts Finland's national 6G Flagship program funded by the Research Council of Finland).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's in CS/EE/Telecom, certified transcripts, statement of purpose, curriculum vitae, and official English test score (IELTS 6.5 or TOEFL 92).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Wireless Communications Engineering and AI are highly competitive due to international interest in the 6G Flagship; a strong mathematics and signals background maximizes admission and funding odds.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: When filling out the application on Studyinfo.fi, always check the box applying for the 'Finland Scholarship / University of Oulu Tuition Fee Waiver'—admission and scholarship are evaluated simultaneously based on composite ranking.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Studyinfo.fi (Finnish National Higher Education Admissions Portal)
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an application on Studyinfo.fi during the joint application period in January, select University of Oulu degree programmes, opt-in for the scholarship, and upload attested document scans.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check programme prerequisites and prepare English test score (IELTS min 6.5 or TOEFL min 92).
Step 2: Submit application on Studyinfo.fi during the annual application window (early to mid-January).
Step 3: Select the checkbox requesting the University of Oulu Tuition Fee Waiver and Finland Scholarship.
Step 4: Upload attested transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and motivational letter by the document deadline.
Step 5: Admissions committee ranks applicants based on academic points and announces results by late March or early April.
Step 6: Accept the study place and scholarship offer via Studyinfo.fi before the national acceptance deadline.
Step 7: Apply for Finnish residence permit for studies through Enter Finland (Migri) and book biometrics at VFS Global Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Track: Single application via Studyinfo.fi covers both program admission and scholarship evaluation.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Not routinely required; uploaded via portal only if specifically requested for specialized tracks.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Integrated motivation questions embedded within the online application addressing academic background, motivation, and career plans.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Short summary of proposed thesis focus in telecommunications, AI, or software engineering.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard academic CV (Europass preferred) detailing academic history, technical skills, and projects.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally evaluated purely on documented academic credentials; video interview used only for borderline cases.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (min 6.5, writing 5.5) or TOEFL iBT (min 92, writing 22); GRE not required.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC Pakistan and MOFA; Matric/Inter by IBCC.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation of all non-English documents.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Bachelor's Degree Certificate and Academic Transcripts
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for 4-year Bachelor's in CS/EE/Telecom with minimum CGPA 3.20/4.00.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Scanned color copies of HEC-attested degrees and semester transcripts.

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (min 6.5 overall, 5.5 writing) or TOEFL iBT (min 92, 22 writing).
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Send electronic score report directly to University of Oulu via testing agency.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Detailed CV listing education, programming abilities, projects, and work experience.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to GitHub and academic project repositories.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured motivation essay answering specific prompt questions on Studyinfo.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Emphasize alignment with Oulu's 6G Flagship or AI initiatives.

required_documents_checklist.specification: High-resolution color scan of passport bio page valid for at least 2 years.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Pakistani passport must be valid through late 2028.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Finland conducts a unified nationwide Joint Application period in January. Missing the mid-January deadline means waiting an entire year.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 60% (Undergraduate GPA and performance in prerequisite mathematical and technical courses)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Undergraduate final year project, publications, and technical depth)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Motivation letter quality and career goal clarity)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty of ITEE Academic Admissions Board at University of Oulu.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Point-based scoring rubric evaluating degree relevance, GPA percentile, and motivation letter quality.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,800 to 2,500 international applicants across ITEE Master's programmes
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 to 200 full/partial tuition waivers and Finland Scholarships
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_global: ~8% to 12% for admission; ~4% to 6% for 100% full scholarship
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~5% to 8% among applicants with strong CGPA (3.4+) in computing and telecom
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: CGPA 3.40+ / 4.00 from top Pakistani engineering institutions (NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET Lahore, NED)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Electrical, telecom, or software engineers with strong calculus, linear algebra, and programming skills.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of top Pakistani computing, electrical, and telecommunication faculties.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Iran, China, Vietnam, Nigeria, Turkey.

fake_websites_and_scams: Beware of fraudulent consultancy firms claiming to guarantee Finnish student visas or scholarships.
Applications must be filed exclusively through opintopolku.fi (Studyinfo.fi).
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Studyinfo.fi and University of Oulu do NOT charge application fees for degree programs.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Oulu does not authorize agents to make admissions or scholarship decisions.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Finnish Migri residence permit electronic fee: €350 (~PKR 105,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: You need to pay the first year tuition before getting the scholarship. Reality: The Finland Scholarship / Oulu waiver is awarded directly in the admission letter and credited upfront.
Myth: You cannot work in Finland during studies. Reality: International students in Finland have the legal right to work up to 30 hours per week during term time.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial agencies suggest spring application deadlines; the actual Finnish Joint Application window closes strictly in mid-January.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must complete at least 60 ECTS credits during the first academic year to renew the tuition fee waiver for the second year.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time campus study and registration in Oulu, Finland.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual transcript audit by the university registrar at the conclusion of spring semester.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to 30 hours per week under Finnish immigration law.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No return obligation; Finland grants a 2-year post-study job seeker residence permit upon graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Zero service bonds or repayment clauses.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is withdrawn if student drops out or fails to meet the 60 ECTS progress threshold.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing major requires a new application in the subsequent joint application round.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Scholarship covers standard 2-year duration; third-year studies incur regular tuition fees unless special waiver granted.
